notes.title: Dev Gameplay
notes.content:
Embark on an electrifying journey through 5 unconventional themed locations, each with 9 levels and a formidable Final Boss waiting to put your skills to the test. Dark Age promises a different and unique gaming experience.

[previewyoutube=zzurD4-enoM;full][/previewyoutube]

Choose from 5 different characters, each with their own unique characteristics, and dive headfirst into this action-packed, fast-paced universe. Excitement knows no bounds in this futuristic masterpiece, and you can try the demo on Steam right now!

[previewyoutube=S0dni5hhuTo;full][/previewyoutube]

A game where emphasis meets intensity, and every punch packs a punch.
